reviews.text: Clean and welcoming. They know me when I (rarely) go pick up my boyfriend's dog and bring her right up. She is always happy to arrive and see her friends.
They don’t separate small dogs from large dogs. Would not recommend if you have a small breed.

We love Urban Paws! I’ve been bringing my pup, Pippa, here for ~8 years for daycare and the occasional boarding. If I ask her in the morning if she wants to “go to Urban Paws,” she gets excited and as soon as we turn on the street, she’s trying to hop into my lap. She jumps right out the car door and doesn’t look back as I tell her “I love you.” She even paws at the door before open it, impatiently waiting to start the day! The owner and team who work here love dogs and I always feel confident leaving her for daycare or boarding. Everyone here is truly the best! I’ve been driving opposite my commute to work, even though there are places closer because she simply loves it here. Thank you, Urban Paws! We love you!

This was Blue’s first time and we will definitely bring him back. It was a scary experience for Blue at first, so it took him a while to warm up. Big thanks to the staff and especially Tiffany. Blue really loved playing with Tiffany!

Our dog Archie stayed at UP over the holiday weekend and I couldn’t be more happy with the experience. From the minute we got there, you could tell everyone there cares so much about the dogs they’re caring for. Every member of the staff has great knowledge on how to best care for your dog based on the information you provide. I plan on recommending UP to any friends or family that need a comfortable place for their dog to stay whether it’s for daycare or boarding. Their great pricing is icing on the cake.

Update: Emily is no longer there. The customer service is still terrible and the groomer that cut him this time cut off a skin tag on my little guy and didn’t say anything. I noticed it once I got home and realized it.

Original Review: Emily always gets my furball looking so handsome! The customer service at the front desk could use some work but otherwise I love it.
Absolutely LOVE Urban Paws!! For both daycare and boarding, the staff here takes such good care of my boy Knox!!
The five star doggy hotel! Looking for a place to take your dog for daycare? Or maybe you want to go on vacation but can't take your pup!? Please before you make your next move give us a call.

I can’t say enough about the quality of service from this facility.  I loved the hotel feel and the ability to bring her blanket and toys for familiarity.  My Malinois had not been exposed to other dogs and people so this was an excellent place where she was able to play in a controlled environment.  She was a bit unsure when we dropped her off but by the time we picked her up she acted right at home.

They even talked about how well she bonded to the staff.  The staff seemed genuinely happy and loving of the animals they worked with, and set my mind at ease leaving her with them.

We had surgery at the nearby hospital which made our boarding days unreliable, the facility worked with us when we had to extend our days and were absolutely fabulous!  They even threw in her bathing since she wasn’t quite ready when we picked her up.

If I ever am in Dallas again I will be bringing her back here.  She acted totally positive about her time here.
We love urban paws!!! My baby has been going there since she was a puppy. The staff is so loving and know each and every  dog there.

I took my pup Raven is who is pretty big for her age and is super friendly but can be really shy around men to Urban Paws for the first time last week. They did an amazing job with her grooming appointment and she left in a great mood! The staff I spoke to- Roman and Blake- were super friendly even before meeting me! 10/10 Raven will be coming back for her next grooming appointment.

My dog, Mookie, has been coming to urban paws for nearly two years and he LOVES it! He always runs to the door because he can’t wait to get inside and play. I love that they get both indoor and outdoor time! The staff is AMAZING, as well!

We ✨L O V E✨ Urban Paws! They always have great service & will even come to the curb to grab your pup! The baths are always top notch & we never hesitate coming here if we have boarding needs!

They always take such good care of our pup & we love seeing how much he is engaged with all the other dogs.

I recently took my 1 yo Golden Retriever for an all day daycare stay. I was really impressed with how communicative the front desk team was with directing me with the documentation needed to enroll him, and when I could bring him in, etc. Communication is key for me! They also gave him a quick wash and dry as he got dirty during play and all complimentary too! I will definitely be back!
Tiffany has been grooming Lola for 3 years now. She is amazing and takes the best care of Miss Lola. I followed her to her spot at Urban Paws because I wouldn’t have anyone else take care of my baby

Great Kennel/Daycare! Great attention to detail and level of care provided to the pups.

Great bath service, my pup loves it!
My pups favorite place to come for baths/boarding. Friendly staff, always remembers my name and shows genuine care for my dog. Highly recommend.
The most amazing spot for my pups… they love to come and play here! Safe fun environment and they are worn out after a day of play.
Ive been taking my baby here for about a year.l for grooming and they always go a great job. It’s a very convenient location for us.
My absolute favorite boarding spot in downtown Dallas! Staff is always helpful and friendly, and pricing is fair! Zebbie and I have been customers for 2+ years and won’t be changing anytime soon.

I have to say Urban Paws is my baby MARVIN‘s favorite place to hang out with his friends and act like a dog. When I travel, I always board him with the wonderful people at the facility in Deep Ellum. That way, I know he’s good taking care of. He’s happy whenever I come to pick him up and he looks well fed. Anyway, if I could give them more stars, I would. Great job guys!

I’ve been bringing my fur baby to urban paws for the last 4 years and it’s the best thing ever. He loves it there and the staff always reassures me that he’s ok and having fun. Honestly one of the best boarding and daycare experiences I’ve had.

I visited last week because I am moving across the street and as I travel frequently I am looking for a place to board my dogs or even just daycare.  Peering through the window I immediately noticed a tall African-American gentleman at the front desk looking down at a tablet / laptop of some sort and not paying attention to the dogs or anything else for that matter.  Despite my better judgement,  I returned the following day to get information and tour the facility.  The same gentleman I saw the previous day was in the daycare room yelling so loud that I could hear him from the front doors.  Upon entering I was greeted by very loud rap hip hop music playing with cuss words.  Completely unprofessional.  I could barely understand the gentleman that was working the front desk.  Apparently he had told me to hold on and while I waited (about 10 minutes) I proceeded to watch chaos play out in front of me. It was a complete circus as they were trying to get the dogs to the owners that were there to pick them up.  I was really looking forward to this place because it is very convenient for me but after I seeing and hearing everything I can only imagine what goes on behind closed doors.  It is apparent that no one is watching the dogs because the daycare area had spots of pee everywhere as the gentleman had left them to watch his game.

This is the first and only place that I’ve ever brought my baby for daycare or boarding. It’s been an amazing experience of the past two years. I’ve never had an issue and they care about him just as much as I do. I’m very grateful to the Urban Paws family for all that they’ve done for us over the years. Anytime I need to leave town. I know he’s going to be well taken care of. They’ve even gone as far as to send me pictures of him when I’m away. It’s nice to know that I can drop him off on a heavy workday and know that he will be taken care of.

Tiffany is a great worker and has a passion for dogs. If I have to leave my dog under someone's care it would be her. I've never seen my dog be as comfortable as he was with her. Keep it up Tiffany thank you for your care for all the dogs that come across your path. Goes above and beyond for any fur babby

Boarded our dog for a few days during the 4th and got him back covered in pee and smelling awful. I guess this was our fault because we didn’t want to pay for a bath before picking him up. He was groomed not even a week before boarding. So does this mean dogs are left to marinate in urine up until they’re pick up day? It’s literally dried in his hair so that’s how I know.
I’ve boarded my 2 huskies, blue bell and cooper, on about 5 different occasions.  I have 0 complaints.  10 out of 10, would recommend!  I feel like I have received excellent service here!

I used to take my dog here because it was so convenient from the house . I came to pick him up one day and saw the staff with a bleached mop bucket cleaning the floor while my dog was in the same kennel. Since then I’ve had nothing put problems with his paw. Why would you clean the kennel and not remove the dogs from the affected area ? This is why we have not been back since and never will

The only boarding facility my pups actually walk into willingly and sometimes have to coax them out! Use them all the time, only thing that would make it better is daily pictures but I know my dogs are happy and well taken care of here.
Thank you for the great service!

My puppy absolutely LOVES this place. We have been apart of the UP fam since she was about 4 months old, and I couldn’t be happier. The staff is caring, efficient, kind, supportive, and they adore my pup…which makes me feel safe leaving her there. Thanks Urban Paws for loving my baby just as much as I do.
Thank you so much for taking care of my pup - highly recommend!
They have taken care of my puppy since we rescued her and it's been an awesome experience.
I have been taking my pup here for years, great staff, he always has fun playing with his buddies here and would highly recommend!

My dog has been going to Urban Paws for about a year and a half now. He does daycare, boarding and gets groomed here. He always comes home happy and healthy (and tired from all the playing he does all day). Everyone that works here is amazing they make me feel so comfortable leaving my dog in their care. I consistently get my dog groomed with Jordan, he nails it every time and always does exactly what I request! Highly recommend!
We love Urban Paws! Our fur baby is always so excited to visit and play ❤️🐕❤️ …

***Dog Parents Beware*** DO NOT BRING YOUR LOVED ONES HERE! My friend, Alyssa,  recently relocated to the area and needed a new grooming home for her 15 year old Maddux. I know she would’ve read reviews, which is why I am writing this one. At first look, this place has decent reviews. On digging deeper, I see that most of the reviews that are lower scored are lower in the listing. They don’t appear in a date order and seem to be listed randomly. Don’t let this fool you. Something is not right here. Maddux was a spry, healthy, adored son to Alyssa who’s been his lifelong mom. Maddux has been professionally groomed and pampered his whole life. He is a friendly and happy boy. This isn’t his first rodeo. He would have presented no challenges to a skilled groomer. Something went horribly wrong that day that has now caused Maddux to lose his eye. In the care of Urban Paws, Alyssa’s Maddux, the most important part of her life, suffered trauma to his eye that was severe enough to result in the need to remove it. Maddux is a strong boy and is on the mend. The Trauma suffered by both Maddux and Alyssa was and is excruciating.Team this trauma with the lack of compassion shown by Urban Paws and their current choice to not respond to Alyssa should be enough to deter everyone from trusting this establishment. Maybe they seem friendly on the surface, maybe they are conveniently located, maybe you’ve seen good reviews, however, this should be the review you don’t pass over. Don’t do it. Every pet parent is an advocate for their loved one/s. If you see something, say something. We are saying it as loud as we can so both your babies and you don’t have to experience and endure this yourselves.

Maddux has lost his eye thanks to months of hell after grooming at Urban Paws. I will never know what happened that day since I was lied to and never told, and since the ER visit that you paid for I haven’t heard back from my email regarding his subsequent pain visits and medications. He was a completely eye healthy dog before this day in June, and the toll it has taken on him, our friends and me — especially to now be ghosted — is a pain I can’t describe. And now my 15 year old baby is having surgery and losing his beautiful eye. After surgery, the biopsy showed that his lens was out of place due to trauma, according to his surgeon. If I can save one dog from entering your doors, then hopefully it won’t be in vain.

Best place to take your puppy for daycare and boarding! New to Dallas and everyone told me to go here, and I could not be happier. My puppy has been going since July, and he loves it. He jumps out of the car ready to go every morning. Amazing place with great people, prices, and convenience!
Came as a walk-in with my dog, Kiko, in to get his nails trimmed & I was in and out within 5 minutes! Thank ya’ll so much for taking care of him & I can’t wait to come back for more!
This place is so great. I love their staff and they take great care of my Doberman who is a handful, she loves coming here every week for daycare.

When I arrived they told me I had to wait for one hour or come back because they were delayed with another dog. I don't mind waiting but they never reached back to me prior to my appointment, and I specifically asked permission for this time at my work. I recommend you to follow back with people before they made the effort to be on time as its supposed to be if you have an appointment.

I don’t know where to start! My fur baby & I love this place! I go here for his grooming, daycare and boarding whenever I’m out of town! The staff are terrific and so genuine. They love kawz and spoil him. I would randomly pop in during his first month to see how he’s adapting around other dogs and let’s just say I was able to function knowing he’s being loved and having fun. He’s always so excited to come here & tired from a full day of fun when he gets home (which is perfect for me after working 12 hours). He’s gotten so many compliments on his grooms whenever we go out. I couldn’t have chosen a better dog family! They genuinely show equal care for every single dog!
My dog Teddy loves his time at Urban Paws; and they love him too…happy dog family
Love bringing Chewie to Urban Paws! He loves his time there and I can genuinely say they treat him like family!

My dog has been going to Urban Paws for years and absolutely loves it! The staff is spectacular, and it is apparent they care about each and every animal that walks through the door! I couldn't recommend this place enough!

My pup “T Bear” and I have used Urban Paws day camp almost daily over the past nine months.  We have also used the boarding plan.

The management and staff are consistently engaged, flexible, and super trustworthy.  I really can’t say enough good things about them.  Urban Paws is a home-run recommendation.
We love Urban Paws!!  Laurel and her team are true animal lovers and do such a great job!  My cavalier loves it!  Top Notch!
Love it

We take our dogs to Urban Paws for day care, boarding and grooming. The staff treats them with love and care and sometimes our pups don't want to leave they are having too much fun. Couldn't recommend enough.
Wendy

5/4/2024 @ 1:40pm witnessed the man in the photo (black male, white tshirt, beating two dogs. We were walking by here and were shocked at what we saw. I’m not from Dallas but I certainly would want to know before bringing my dog here. Reported this to Urban Paws immediately, Dallas Police and the SPCA.
